description: The pie chart shows the distribution of observations across six labeled categories (0 through 5), with each slice annotated by a percentage and a count in parentheses. There are 6 slices: category 0 is a very light cream slice at about 13.3% (3910), category 1 is a pale yellow slice at about 13.8% (4046), category 2 is a light green slice at about 22.4% (6583), category 3 is a light olive-green slice at about 6.8% (2002), category 4 is a very light blue slice at about 6.2% (1810), and category 5 is a light blue slice at about 10.4% (3043); an additional larger light blue slice at the top is labeled 27.2% (8006) but has no visible category label adjacent to it in the figure. The chart includes percentage-and-count labels inside the slices, there is no legend shown, and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized; the slices do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
